title: Irish Pasta Bake
description: A hearty pasta bake infused with the flavors of Ireland, featuring serrano ham and a tangy twist.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the pasta sauce over medium heat. Add the sliced serrano ham and cook until heated through.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, pasta sauce mixture, and chopped parsley. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with shredded mozzarella. Sprinkle with a pinch of yzesty.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
